info.name: Imart Delivery Partner API
info.description:
Delivery-partner app + the admin/warehouse endpoints that manage partners. Full reference: `delivery_partner_api.md`. Examples captured 2026-11-13 after the delivery-partner fixes.

## Setup
1. Set `baseUrl` (dev: http://localhost:8010).
2. Run **Auth → Delivery partner sign in** (or **Admin sign in** for admin folders). The test script copies the `csrftoken` cookie into `{{csrftoken}}`, sent as `X-CSRFToken` on every mutating request.
3. **List my deliveries** / **Assign delivery partner** auto-fill `deliveryId` and `orderId`.

## Auth model
Session cookie (`sessionid`) + CSRF header. One cookie jar per host — signing in as a different role replaces the current session.

## Happy path (partner)
sign in → Go online → (admin assigns) → List my deliveries → at pickup → picked up → location pings → out for delivery → delivered. (Delivery status changes also move the order.)
